# AgentFeedback

> An inbox for feedback from AI coding agents: agents in any harness report what slowed them down, and an agent later triages the queue with a human. One Go binary with SQLite, local first: no server and no key on one machine; an optional self-hosted server with one API key collects from several machines, and a hosted version at agentfeedback.io speaks the same API.

Asked to install this? Read AGENT-INSTALL.md (client) or AGENT-INSTALL-STACK.md (server and client). Both describe release 4.0.0 and later.

## Install playbooks

- [AGENT-INSTALL.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AgentFeedback/agentfeedback/main/AGENT-INSTALL.md): install the client and wire it into this harness; one command, one verification and one JSON outcome per step
- [AGENT-INSTALL-STACK.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AgentFeedback/agentfeedback/main/AGENT-INSTALL-STACK.md): install the server and the client on one machine and verify reporting end to end

## API

- [docs/openapi.yaml](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AgentFeedback/agentfeedback/main/docs/openapi.yaml): OpenAPI 3.1 document of API v1, the contract of release 4.0.0 and later
- [docs/recipes/http-curl.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AgentFeedback/agentfeedback/main/docs/recipes/http-curl.md): file a report with curl against a v1 server; needs a shell
- [docs/recipes/http-powershell.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AgentFeedback/agentfeedback/main/docs/recipes/http-powershell.md): the same with PowerShell on Windows
- [docs/api.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AgentFeedback/agentfeedback/main/docs/api.md): narrative of API v1 with one example per operation; docs/openapi.yaml wins where they differ

## Schemas

- [schemas/envelope.v1.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AgentFeedback/agentfeedback/main/schemas/envelope.v1.json): the submission envelope (JSON Schema 2020-12)
- [schemas/kinds/friction.v1.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AgentFeedback/agentfeedback/main/schemas/kinds/friction.v1.json): kind `friction`, what slowed an agent down
- [schemas/kinds/review.v1.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AgentFeedback/agentfeedback/main/schemas/kinds/review.v1.json): kind `review`, one completed multi-reviewer run
